mapper.update: UPDATE dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record source_record SET status = 'skip', remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE source_record.is_deleted = false AND source_record.platform_code = #{platformCode} AND source_record.track_no <> '' AND source_record.status IN ('wait', 'ing') AND ( source_record.status = 'wait' OR ( source_record.status = 'ing' AND source_record.update_time <= NOW() - (#{timeoutMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute') ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record newer_record WHERE newer_record.is_deleted = false AND newer_record.platform_code = source_record.platform_code AND newer_record.track_no = source_record.track_no AND newer_record.status IN ('wait', 'ing', 'finish') AND ( newer_record.create_time > source_record.create_time OR ( newer_record.create_time = source_record.create_time AND newer_record.id > source_record.id ) ) )

UPDATE dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record source_record SET status = 'wait', remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE source_record.is_deleted = false AND source_record.platform_code = #{platformCode} AND source_record.track_no <> '' AND source_record.status = 'ing' AND source_record.update_time <= NOW() - (#{timeoutMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record newer_record WHERE newer_record.is_deleted = false AND newer_record.platform_code = source_record.platform_code AND newer_record.track_no = source_record.track_no AND newer_record.status IN ('wait', 'ing', 'finish') AND ( newer_record.create_time > source_record.create_time OR ( newer_record.create_time = source_record.create_time AND newer_record.id > source_record.id ) ) )
mapper.select: UPDATE dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record source_record SET status = 'ing', update_time = NOW() WHERE source_record.id IN ( SELECT wait_record.id FROM dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record wait_record WHERE wait_record.is_deleted = false AND wait_record.platform_code = #{platformCode} AND wait_record.status = 'wait' AND wait_record.track_no <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dmp_logistics_track_webhook_record newer_record WHERE newer_record.is_deleted = false AND newer_record.platform_code = wait_record.platform_code AND newer_record.track_no = wait_record.track_no AND newer_record.status IN ('wait', 'ing', 'finish') AND ( newer_record.create_time > wait_record.create_time OR ( newer_record.create_time = wait_record.create_time AND newer_record.id > wait_record.id ) ) ) ORDER BY wait_record.create_time ASC, wait_record.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) AND source_record.is_deleted = false RETURNING source_record.*
